boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct, university-documented settings for quiet work, group projects, and academic media production.

cards.title: Chase Tower Reading Room
cards.subtitle: MIKC 300, Mathewson-IGT Knowledge Center
cards.notes: Set up here for independent reading or writing, using the room’s tables and lamps; keep noise restricted and check the floor map before arrival.
cards.short_summary: A restricted-noise reading room with table lamps and large windows.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries lists MIKC 300 Chase Tower Reading Room as a restricted-noise space with table lamps, natural light, and room-darkening shades.
cards.access_notes: Located on the third floor of the Mathewson-IGT Knowledge Center; follow the library's restricted-noise expectation.

cards.title: Fifth Floor Quiet Study
cards.subtitle: Mathewson-IGT Knowledge Center
cards.notes: Use the fifth floor for a solo work block, choosing a carrel or table and keeping conversation low; it also has nearby printing and bottle fillers.
cards.short_summary: A quiet library floor with carrels, tables, computers, and group rooms nearby.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries identifies the fifth floor of the Knowledge Center as a restricted-noise quiet study floor with study carrels, tables, computers, printing, and four group study rooms.
cards.access_notes: This is a designated quiet-study floor; keep noise restricted and consult library hours before visiting.

cards.title: Group Study Room 423
cards.subtitle: Fourth floor, Mathewson-IGT Knowledge Center
cards.notes: Book this eight-person room for a project meeting, then bring a laptop to connect to its monitor and collect whiteboard supplies from the desk if needed.
cards.short_summary: An eight-person reservable group room in the Knowledge Center.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries lists MIKC Group Study Room 423 on the fourth floor with a capacity of eight and makes fourth-floor Knowledge Center group rooms reservable online.
cards.access_notes: Reserve through the University Libraries portal; reservations need advance notice, and unreserved rooms may be first-come, first-served.

cards.title: Group Study Room 520
cards.subtitle: Fifth floor, Mathewson-IGT Knowledge Center
cards.notes: Use this eight-person room when a group needs a shared table, monitor, and whiteboard; confirm the booking card outside before settling in.
cards.short_summary: An eight-person fifth-floor room for collaborative academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries lists MIKC Group Study Room 520 on the fifth floor with a capacity of eight; group rooms include a conference table, monitor, and whiteboard.
cards.access_notes: Book online when needed; if unreserved, check the posted reservation card before using the room.

cards.title: Faculty and Graduate Reserved Studies
cards.subtitle: MIKC 421, Mathewson-IGT Knowledge Center
cards.notes: Graduate students and faculty can request access for quiet work with carrels, computers, tables, and outlets; apply for WolfCard activation ahead of time.
cards.short_summary: A key-card-access quiet zone for authorized faculty and graduate students.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries states that suite 421 is a designated quiet zone for authorized faculty and graduate students, with assigned studies, lockers, computers, outlets, tables, and chairs.
cards.source_title: Faculty and graduate study spaces | University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Restricted to authorized faculty and graduate students; WolfCard activation is required and may take 5–7 business days.

cards.title: Student Collaboration Room 202A
cards.subtitle: Second floor, DeLaMare Science and Engineering Library
cards.notes: Reserve this room for a group session of up to eight, and plan a focused agenda so the shared monitor and whiteboard support the work.
cards.short_summary: A reservable DeLaMare group room for up to eight people.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries lists DeLaMare Library's second-floor Student Collaboration Room 202A with a capacity of eight and identifies it as reservable online.
cards.access_notes: Reserve through University Libraries; check the current reservation policy and advance-notice requirement before visiting.

cards.title: Lilli Brant Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Third floor, DeLaMare Science and Engineering Library
cards.notes: Schedule the room for a larger collaborative session or event, verifying capacity and reservation eligibility before inviting the group.
cards.short_summary: A third-floor collaborative study room and event space at DeLaMare.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries describes the Lilli Brant Reading Room as a collaborative study room and event space on the third floor of DeLaMare Science and Engineering Library.
cards.access_notes: The group-study policy says this room may be scheduled only by groups of eight or more; use the current reservation process.

cards.title: DataWorks South
cards.subtitle: Basement, DeLaMare Science and Engineering Library
cards.notes: Choose DataWorks South for software-heavy coursework, then save files to your own storage and confirm the library is open before heading in.
cards.short_summary: An 18-workstation lab for data, engineering, and technical software.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries states that DataWorks South is in DeLaMare's basement and has 18 dual-monitor PC workstations with GIS, statistics, CAD, and other specialty software.
cards.source_title: Specialty tech spaces at DeLaMare | University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Open during DeLaMare Library hours; confirm current building hours and any lab-use requirements before visiting.

cards.title: DeLaMare Audio Room
cards.subtitle: Second floor, DeLaMare Science and Engineering Library
cards.notes: Reserve the audio room for a recorded presentation or editing session, and allow time to check out the key from the Makerspace desk.
cards.short_summary: A recording room with an isolation booth, microphones, and editing software.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries describes the second-floor DeLaMare Audio Room as having an isolation booth, two microphones, and professional recording and editing software; reservations are strongly recommended.
cards.source_title: Specialty tech spaces at DeLaMare | University Libraries
cards.access_notes: A key is checked out from the Makerspace desk; online reservations are strongly recommended to ensure availability.

cards.title: Dynamic Media Lab
cards.subtitle: MIKC 108, Mathewson-IGT Knowledge Center
cards.notes: Use a dual-monitor Mac workstation to edit class media, and check whether the lab is available before beginning a longer production session.
cards.short_summary: An 18-workstation media-production lab for video, audio, graphics, and editing.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries locates the Dynamic Media Lab in MIKC 108 and lists 18 dual-monitor Mac Studio workstations, recording rooms, and video and audio editing software.
cards.access_notes: Available when the Knowledge Center is open and the lab is not in use by a class; verify current hours and availability.
